Package com.hkust.marketplace.services

Record Class HistoryQuery

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.hkust.marketplace.services.HistoryQuery
Record Components:
from - the first day of the date range, or null for no start
to - the last day of the date range, or null for no end
category - null for every category
seller - part of the seller's name as typed; blank for no search
public record HistoryQuery(LocalDate from, LocalDate to, Category category, String seller) extends Record
What the buyer chose on Deal History (UC11 step 3): a date range, a category and part of a seller's name. Every part is optional; ALL asks for every completed deal, which is what the screen shows when it opens (step 2).

The dates are kept as chosen. DealHistoryService.find(com.hkust.marketplace.services.HistoryQuery) checks their order (A2), so the check is in one tested place and not in the screen.
